description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value on your client for each request. The **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length.
